DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Year-Month],
			'Date'[Year-Month number],
			"Total_AI_cost_MoM__", IGNORE('_Measures'[Total AI cost MoM %]),
			"Total_AI_cost", '_Measures'[Total AI cost]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Date'[Year-Month number], 1, 'Date'[Year-Month], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Year-Month number], 'Date'[Year-Month]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Payments'[Host], "Spend", '_Measures'[Spend])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Spend], 0, 'Payments'[Host], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Spend] DESC, 'Payments'[Host]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Payments'[Pay to], "Spend", '_Measures'[Spend])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Spend], 0, 'Payments'[Pay to], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Spend] DESC, 'Payments'[Pay to]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Total_AI_cost", '_Measures'[Total AI cost],
		"Model_cost", '_Measures'[Model cost],
		"Spend", '_Measures'[Spend],
		"Paid_not_delivered", '_Measures'[Paid not delivered],
		"Paid_not_delivered_USD", '_Measures'[Paid not delivered USD],
		"Cost_coverage", '_Measures'[Cost coverage],
		"Total_AI_cost_MoM__", '_Measures'[Total AI cost MoM %],
		"Model_cost_MoM__", '_Measures'[Model cost MoM %],
		"Spend_MoM__", '_Measures'[Spend MoM %]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				ROLLUPGROUP('Date'[Date], 'Payments'[Host], 'Payments'[Pay to], 'Payments'[Run ID]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
			),
			"Paid_not_delivered_USD", '_Measures'[Paid not delivered USD]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			'Date'[Date],
			0,
			'Payments'[Host],
			1,
			'Payments'[Pay to],
			1,
			'Payments'[Run ID],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	'Date'[Date] DESC,
	'Payments'[Host],
	'Payments'[Pay to],
	'Payments'[Run ID]
